data.body: Phase-2 mutation exposed and confirmed a second occurrence of the same ambient Path-factory mechanism that the original CI stack could not reach: after stabilizing the two tests/conftest.py conversions, a non-empty snapshot advances into src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:145, where `_rmtree_writable` also evaluates `Path(dirpath)` and raises the same Python 3.11 WindowsPath NotImplementedError while os.name remains monkeypatched. This is one root-cause class with two sequential artifacts, not a rival cause. Exact mutation evidence: restoring both original conftest Path calls makes the held-out oracle RED at conftest.py:358; stabilizing those conversions but removing the scoped snapshot.Path binding makes the same oracle RED at snapshot.py:145; restoring both protections returns GREEN. The fix remains test-harness scoped and preserves `_rmtree_writable` production behavior for every non-test caller.
